subtheme: Teaching models to reason step by step

subsubthemes.name: Training with rewards and feedback
subsubthemes.gist: Learning from signals that tell the model when its reasoning is correct, using methods like reinforcement learning to improve step-by-step answers.

subsubthemes.name: Breaking down complex problems into smaller steps
subsubthemes.gist: Teaching models to decompose hard problems into manageable pieces and solve them sequentially, rather than jumping to the answer.

subsubthemes.name: Checking and fixing reasoning as it goes
subsubthemes.gist: Using verification models and self-correction to catch and repair errors during reasoning, rather than waiting until the final answer.

subsubthemes.name: Learning to think in hidden layers
subsubthemes.gist: Training models to do most of their reasoning internally in the model weights, rather than spelling everything out in text.

subsubthemes.name: Making reasoning faster and shorter
subsubthemes.gist: Finding ways to get good answers with less thinking time or fewer reasoning steps, balancing quality against speed and cost.

subsubthemes.name: Teaching with examples and gradual difficulty
subsubthemes.gist: Using ordered examples (easy to hard) and learning from other models to help faster models or smaller models learn to reason better.

subsubthemes.name: Reasoning with tools and external knowledge
subsubthemes.gist: Training models to call calculators, code interpreters, search engines, and other tools as part of their reasoning process.
